skill.name: setup-macbook-productivity
skill.description: Configure macOS Dictation and its Control-Control shortcut, verify the resulting preferences, and open Keyboard settings for user approval when needed.
skill.summary: Set up and verify macOS Dictation with a repeatable Control-Control shortcut.
skill.author: arthurzakirov

security_audit.summary: All 21 static findings are false positives in context. The skill uses fixed local macOS commands to configure Dictation, inspect preferences, restart named services, and open Keyboard settings; no network access or prompt injection was found.

remediation.issue: The bundled script runs external commands and restarts named preference services.
remediation.suggestion: Keep command arguments fixed, retain the macOS platform check, and document the affected processes before execution.

remediation.issue: The script writes the user preference plist directly.
remediation.suggestion: Create a backup of the existing preference file before writing it and provide a rollback procedure.

remediation.issue: Dictation settings can affect microphone and privacy behavior.
remediation.suggestion: Continue requiring user approval for macOS privacy prompts and explain that audio sharing is optional.

content.value_statement: Mac users may struggle to enable Dictation and its shortcut consistently. This skill applies the supported settings, verifies them, and opens Keyboard settings for approval.
actual_capabilities: Checks whether the host is macOS before changing settings.
Enables the documented macOS Dictation preference flags.
Sets the Dictation shortcut to pressing Control twice.
Restarts named preference services so changes take effect.
Opens macOS Keyboard settings for required user approval.
Reads Dictation preferences and prints verification results.
limitations: It does not bypass privacy prompts or approve them for the user.
It does not enable full Voice Control.
Microphone access and language downloads may require manual configuration.

use_cases.title: New Mac setup
use_cases.description: Enable Dictation and configure a reliable shortcut during initial MacBook setup.

use_cases.title: Dictation repair
use_cases.description: Reapply Dictation preferences and inspect the Keyboard settings when voice typing stops working.

use_cases.title: Repeatable workstation setup
use_cases.description: Document and repeat a local Dictation configuration across managed personal workstations.

prompt_templates.title: Enable Dictation
prompt_templates.prompt: Set up macOS Dictation with the Control-Control shortcut. Ask me to approve any privacy prompt.

prompt_templates.title: Verify Dictation
prompt_templates.prompt: Check whether macOS Dictation is enabled and report the current shortcut and preference state.

prompt_templates.title: Repair voice typing
prompt_templates.prompt: Repair macOS voice typing with the bundled workflow, then open Keyboard settings and list any manual steps remaining.

prompt_templates.title: Standardize a Mac
prompt_templates.prompt: Apply the documented Dictation configuration on this Mac, verify each setting, and provide a concise audit of changes and user approvals.

output_examples.input: Enable Dictation with the standard shortcut.
output_examples.output: Dictation preferences were updated. Keyboard settings are open so you can approve any required macOS prompt. Test by pressing Control twice.

output_examples.input: Why is voice typing still unavailable?
output: Confirm Dictation is enabled in Keyboard settings.
Check the selected microphone and required privacy approval.
Set the shortcut to Press Control Key Twice.

best_practices: Confirm the host is macOS before applying settings.
Let the user approve privacy and audio-sharing prompts.
Verify the shortcut and Dictation flags after setup.
anti_patterns: Do not bypass macOS privacy prompts.
Do not enable Voice Control unless the user requests it.
Do not assume microphone access or language downloads are complete.

faq.question: What does this skill configure?
faq.answer: It enables macOS Dictation and sets the shortcut to pressing Control twice.

faq.question: Does it work on Windows or Linux?
faq.answer: No. The bundled workflow supports macOS only.

faq.question: Will it approve privacy prompts?
faq.answer: No. It opens Keyboard settings and requires the user to approve prompts.

faq.question: Does it share audio with Apple?
faq.answer: No. The workflow recommends Not Now unless the user explicitly wants audio sharing.

faq.question: Does it enable Voice Control?
faq.answer: No. It configures standard Dictation and leaves Voice Control disabled.

faq.question: How do I test the shortcut?
faq.answer: Focus any text field and press Control twice. Press Escape or the shortcut again to stop.
